purpose: estimate the image-level prevalence of visible but unannotated footballs, independently of any model
primary_endpoint: image-level missing-ball defect rate: an image is positive if it contains >=1 visible football that lacks an annotation
presentation_order: the seeded draw order, so reviewer fatigue does not align with split or run
descriptive_variables_note: split, run, ball_gt_count, gt_state and view_proxy are recorded for post-hoc description only. They were NOT used for inclusion, and subgroup counts must not be quoted as per-subgroup rates.
